t: [2411.18194] mumax+: extensible GPU-accelerated micromagnetics and beyond
s: August 19, 2025 - Abstract:We present mumax+, an extensible GPU-accelerated micromagnetic simulator with a Python user interface, to address the challenges posed by current magnetism research into systems with complex magnetic ordering and interfaces. It is a general solver for the space- and time-dependent evolution of the magnetization and related vector quantities, using finite difference discretization.
